apps.name: Math Viz
apps.description: An interactive environment for exploring mathematical equations, curves, and surfaces. Adjust parameters and examine the results in two and three dimensions.
apps.imageAlt: Math Viz plotting a three-dimensional sine and cosine surface with parameter controls

apps.name: Tower Defense
apps.description: A strategy game built around tower placement and resource management. Build and upgrade defenses to protect your base against successive waves of enemies.
apps.imageAlt: Tower Defense gameplay with towers defending the base against incoming spacecraft

apps.name: Space Invaders
apps.description: Move your ship, dodge incoming fire and clear waves of aliens. Aim for a new high score as the levels speed up.
apps.imageAlt: Space Invaders gameplay with alien formations, defensive barriers and the player's ship

apps.name: Game of Life
apps.description: Watch a random field of cells evolve under Conway’s rules. Adjust the board, density and speed to explore changing patterns.
apps.imageAlt: Game of Life browser app showing green evolving cell patterns with board and density settings

apps.name: Rover
apps.tagline: A LEGO rover on the move
apps.description: Drive a LEGO rover across a scrolling landscape. Move left and right, jump and boost again in midair using keyboard or on-screen controls.
apps.imageAlt: Rover browser game showing the LEGO rover on a scrolling landscape with game settings

apps.name: Go RPG
apps.description: Explore a tiled board, battle monsters and collect treasure and health packs. Built in Go with keyboard and on-screen controls.
apps.imageAlt: Go RPG showing the player, monsters and health pickups on a tiled board
